articles.summary: Drone manufacturers competing for defence and government programs need more than compliant designs. They need evidence that production electronics remain authentic, consistent, and trustworthy from supplier to final system. See how Palitronica helps turn design intent into verifiable supply chain assurance.
articles.title: How Palitronica Supports NIST 800.53 compliance support for defense contractors and UAS/Drone manufacturers

articles.summary: See how Palitronica supports NIST SP 800-53 supply chain controls with independent hardware and firmware verification for provenance, supplier assurance, tamper detection, inspection and component authenticity.
articles.title: Strengthen NIST SP 800-53 Supply Chain Assurance for Defense Electronics
